mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0% triggers investor fear of inflation, leading to short-term selling of equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0, or the trigger does not occur within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in UNRATE above 5.0% signals rising unemployment, prompting risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the next 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0%, or the trigger does not materialize.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (GDP) growth signals robust economic activity, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (supply index) reflects stronger production capacity, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO rising, or weak correlation (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and UNRATE (lower unemployment) create a dual expansion signal, amplifying investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS signals stronger easing, which disproportionately boosts equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the late-cycle regime despite FEDFUNDS easing.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) reflect robust economic momentum, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite both proxies rising, or low positive correlation (IC < 0.03).
